text: I am writing to request parking amendments to Stornoway Court to reduce frequent incidents of congestion and blocking of driveways. In consultation with local residents and as part of a larger traffic review across Ward 25, making Stornoway Court “no standing” will address issues constituents have continuously raised.
The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited standing at all times on the south side of Stornoway Court, between Manse Road and the north end of Stornoway Court.
